title: Renewal of Operating Lines of Credit for a Further Term
content:
Only an Operating Lines of Credit product that is renewable can be renewed; a Seasonal Operating Loan matures and a new loan is applied for.

## Rules

1. **Renewal window.** A renewal request may be accepted no earlier than the product's renewal application window, in calendar days, before the maturity date of the current term. The days are counted backwards from the maturity date as calendar days, the maturity date itself being day 0, and the first day of the window qualifies. The maturity date is read from the association's record of the line.
2. **Registration and decision.** The request is registered as a renewal request, in submitted status, with the commitment the member asks for, and is decided by a credit officer.
3. **Line status.** A renewal may be processed only while the line is in active or matured status; a suspended line must first be reinstated under the rules for frozen advances and reinstatement.
4. **Type of review.** The renewal is approved under streamlined review when the line's count of streamlined renewals is below the product's streamlined allowance, otherwise under full review. A streamlined renewal adds 1 to the count; a full review resets it to 0. When the product requires financial statements with a renewal, the request is not decided until a current balance sheet and income statement are received.
5. **Effective date and new term.** A renewal of an active line takes effect the day after the current maturity date, and the new maturity date is the old one plus the product's term in calendar months. A renewal of a matured line takes effect on its approval date, and the new maturity date is that date plus the product's term in calendar months.
6. **Maturity without renewal.** A line still in active status at the end of its maturity date with no renewal in effect matures.
7. **Rate and fee.** On the renewal effective date the contract rate is reset and the product's renewal fee is assessed. The renewal fee is waived on the basis of early renewal when the renewal request was registered at least the product's early-renewal waiver period, in calendar days, before the maturity date of the term being renewed. A matured line never qualifies, and a product whose early-renewal waiver period is 0 has no early-renewal waiver.

## Window boundary (hypothetical, 120-day window, maturity date 30 November)

| Request date | Days before maturity | Accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 1 August | 121 | No — before the window opens |
| 2 August | 120 (the first day of the window) | Yes |
| 15 October | 46 | Yes |

## Early-renewal waiver (hypothetical, 60-day waiver period, maturity date 30 November)

| Renewal request registered | Days before maturity | Renewal fee |
|---|---|---|
| 1 October | 60 | Waived (early renewal) |
| 2 October | 59 | Charged |

## Effective dates (hypothetical, 12-month term)

- An active line maturing on 30 November and renewed takes effect on 1 December; the new maturity date is 30 November of the following year.
- A line that matured on 30 November and whose renewal is approved on 20 December takes effect on 20 December; the new maturity date is 20 December of the following year.
